text: The purpose of this staff report is to provide an update on Central Intake shelter access data indicators and trends. This includes a description of recent enhancements to Central Intake; an update on shelter system capacity and changes related to COVID-19; a report on Central Intake call volumes, key performance indicators, and its referral process; and an update on available data describing the current demand for shelter spaces. This report finds that while Central Intake continues to meet its customer service targets despite unprecedented increases in call volume, demand continues to be hard to predict and there may be individuals who are not able to access a shelter space through Central Intake within a 24-hour period.
